title: Manyhands JSON v1 commit identity
description: The identity a commit in the repository would carry, and the initials a short code would be composed with.

source.description: The level of Git configuration that holds the name and the email. With none, both are null.

initials.description: The initials a short code assigned now, with none given for the call, would be composed with: two or three ASCII letters or digits in lower case. Null when initials_source is none.

initials_source.description: Where the initials come from: repository is manyhands.initials in the repository's own Git configuration, and derived is the name. A manyhands.initials that is not two or three ASCII letters or digits is not used and nothing is derived in its place: that is none, as is a name initials cannot be derived from.
